pytorch.reason: compute det(A)^{1/n} for varying GL matrices; autograd d(det^{1/3})/dA; polar decomp via SVD; scale = product of singular values

pyg.reason: not used — scale bridge is a matrix-level test; no graph message-passing required

z3.reason: UNSAT: det(A)=1 AND scale != 1 — if det=1 then geometric mean scale = 1, structural constraint

cvc5.reason: not used — z3 covers the proof layer for this sim

sympy.reason: symbolic polar decomp for 2x2: A=[[a,b],[c,d]], det=ad-bc, scale=(det)^{1/2} for 2x2; show scale is independent of rotation angle

clifford.reason: grade-0 scalar in Cl(3,0) = the scale; polar decomp = separating grade-0 from grades 1-3; grade-0 nonzero for GL\O matrices

geomstats.reason: GeneralLinear(n=3): sample random GL elements; compute singular values (scale); verify SVs=1 exactly for orthogonal matrices

e3nn.reason: not used — scale bridge is matrix algebraic; no equivariant network required

rustworkx.reason: scale DOF graph: nodes={GL_scale_dof, O_no_scale, SL3_det1, SU3_det1}; directed edges where scale is eliminated; verify GL is root node

xgi.reason: not used — scale bridge is matrix algebraic; no hypergraph topology required

toponetx.reason: not used — scale bridge is matrix algebraic; no cell complex required

gudhi.reason: not used — scale bridge is matrix algebraic; no persistent homology required

P1_pytorch_gl3_nonunit_scale.description: GL(3,R) matrices have det^{1/3} != 1 — free scale degree of freedom (Axis 2 active)

P2_pytorch_o3_unit_scale.description: O(3)/SO(3) matrices have det^{1/3} = 1 exactly — scale (Axis 2) is frozen at 1

P3_pytorch_polar_decomp_scale_consistent.description: Polar decomp M=Q*S: reconstruction error < 1e-8; scale = geometric mean of singular values

P4_pytorch_scale_varies_continuously_wit.description: Scale det^{1/3} varies continuously and monotonically as det(A) varies 0.5->2.0

P5_pytorch_autograd_scale_gradient_nonze.description: Autograd: d(det^{1/3})/dA is nonzero — scale is a differentiable DOF of GL

P6_sympy_scale_independent_of_rotation.description: Sympy 2x2 polar: scale = sqrt(det) = r is independent of rotation angle theta (d/dtheta = 0)

P7_clifford_scaled_rotor_norm_equals_sca.description: Clifford: |rotor| = 1 for unit rotor; |s*rotor| = s for scaled rotor — norm IS the scale (Axis 2)

P8_geomstats_gl3_nonunit_singular_values.description: Geomstats GL(3): random samples have singular values != 1 (scale DOF active)

P9_rustworkx_gl_root_free_scale.description: Scale DOF graph: GL is the unique root node with free_scale; all descendants have frozen scale

N1_pytorch_o3_no_scale_variation.description: Negative: SO(3) matrices always have scale = 1 exactly — Axis 2 frozen

N2_z3_det1_implies_scale1.description: Z3 UNSAT: det(A)=1 AND scale != 1 — geometric mean scale is structurally 1 when det=1

N3_sympy_so2_scale_equals_1.description: Sympy: SO(2) polar rep with r=1 gives scale = 1 exactly — no scale DOF

N4_clifford_unit_rotor_norm_1.description: Clifford: unit rotor cos(t)+sin(t)*e12 has norm = 1 exactly — no scale component

N5_geomstats_so3_svs_all_one.description: Geomstats SO(3) samples: all singular values are 1 exactly — scale frozen

N6_rustworkx_no_reverse_scale_edge.description: G-tower DAG: no edge from O back to GL — scale cannot be regained once removed

B1_pytorch_sl3_boundary_scale_1.description: Boundary: det(A)=1 SL(3,R) matrix has scale = det^{1/3} = 1 exactly — Axis 2 = 0

B2_sympy_sl2_scale_equals_1.description: Sympy 2x2: when det=1, scale=sqrt(1)=1; the SL boundary is exactly scale=1 (Axis 2 = 0)

B3_pytorch_scale_monotone_with_det.description: Boundary: scale = det^{1/3} is monotonically non-decreasing as det varies from 0.5 to 2.0

B4_z3_det2_scale_greater_1_sat.description: Z3 SAT: det=2 AND scale>1 is consistent (scale=2^{1/3} > 1) — GL has free scale DOF

B5_clifford_scale_factor_equals_norm_rat.description: Boundary: scale factor = |scaled_rotor| / |unit_rotor| exactly; Axis 2 = norm ratio

B6_geomstats_sv_product_equals_det.description: Geomstats GL(3): product of singular values = |det(A)| — scale = det^{1/3}
